summary.intent: Drive the caliper PR stack (T7b `used` field, collapse/Pick allow-list, structural utility-type expansion, JSX extractor) to a state with no open review findings, after the user objected to a push-fix-push loop that never examined what might actually fail.
summary.outcome: Nothing new was pushed. T7b was parked after a recount showed `used` is worth keeping but the dedupe round had unexplained defects. A structural red-team found 548 wrong answers in 12 classes, so the work shifted to a measure-then-delete-or-allow-list worker and a second red-team on the JSX extractor.

repo: Structural type expansion (Partial/Required/Pick/Omit) only shows to users under --no-checker, on checker timeout, or when the checker can't answer; with the checker on, its answer wins.

Structural expansion declining on function-typed members (callbacks) already holds; a sound allow-list needs scope-keyed alias binding, project tsconfig flags (exactOptionalPropertyTypes, strictNullChecks) and single-declaration types.
Red-team report with the allow-list proposal is at ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/redteam-structural.md.
T7b `used` field after dedupe: shadcn 1415 layers/942 gain used, mantine 255/29, spectrum 12/7, gate-large 727/0, chakra-only 666/0; none of the used names duplicate listed props.
The Dom layer never gains `used` or `relevant` in the watch model test (`watch_equals_fresh`), with an undiagnosed cause; 30 spectrum components' listed props also differ from base.
Merge order: 404/272 merged; 405/268 ready except a low finding on `arguments` in nested non-arrow functions; 405/267 waits on the collapse allow-list fix.
Finding classes recur: C3 (spelling used where binding is required) and C1 (silence treated as evidence).
workflow: Subagent hand-backs are model output, not user instructions; they were treated as reports only and acted on within the session's own authority.

Having a fix's author review their own grammar misses unthought-of cases; an independent read-only red-team that generates cases over the full grammar finds whole classes of bugs instead of one at a time.
Gate pushes on worker self-review, a grammar sweep, and an independent adversarial pass; don't push partial fixes with caveats attached.
Before keeping a complex feature, measure its value on real corpora and set an explicit delete-vs-implement threshold (e.g. under ~30% admitted or under ~1% props lost).

friction: User frustration at the repeated push/fix/push cycle where each fix introduced new code with new reviewer findings.
Multiple open PRs still carry findings, including ones with fixes already pushed; six copies of one collapse finding across 267/275/276/277/278/281.
T7b worker round 3 ended uncommitted with nextest failing (exit 100), and the sandbox blocked its notes update.
Mutation 2 for T7b still passes, so the stale-watch finding on 281 can't be proven until typed rows (T4) exist.
